Meta.title: Skyloom — Virtual Drone Show Studio
Meta.description: Design, fly and share a 3D drone light show in your browser. Real flight speeds, collision-free routes, thousands of drones.

Site.footerNote: A virtual drone show simulator. No real aircraft are flown.

Stage.fallbackBody: This browser has no WebGPU, so the show runs on WebGL2 with up to {count, number} drones.

Quick.empty: No formations yet — create one below

Quick.uploadHint: Drop a picture, SVG or .glb model anywhere on this panel. The drones take its shape and colours.
Quick.realisticHint: Limits every drone to the top speed below and plans routes that keep them apart.

Landing.title: Draw on the night sky
Landing.tagline: Thousands of drones lift off, fly at real speeds and build 3D formations you design.
Landing.hint: Drag to orbit · scroll or pinch to zoom

gallery.title: Pick a show and fly it
gallery.lead: Choose a show and the fleet above re-forms into it. Then change anything you like.

how.title: Planned like a real show
how.lead: Real drone shows are choreographed before take-off. Skyloom does the same three jobs in your browser.

design.title: Design
design.body: Shapes, words, 3D models and your own pictures are sampled into evenly spaced points — one per drone, coloured from the source.

animate.title: Animate
animate.body: Each drone is assigned the nearest free point, routes are checked for conflicts, and timing is stretched until nobody exceeds the fleet's top speed.

share.title: Share
share.body: The whole show fits in a link. Send it, export a video, or save it as a preset and keep editing.
